Maya (People Ops): Heads-up  new Eng Manager (Nora) starts Mon 09:00 PT. Tiny preboarding checklist below. Please confirm your items by EOD Fri.

Maya (People Ops): Day-before essentials:
- Device shipped & imaged
- Okta + MFA invite sent
- Slack + email + calendar provisioned
- Notion access to /team/eng/managers granted
- 1Password manager vault access granted
- Welcome email with week-1 agenda queued

Riley (IT): Device imaged (MacBook Pro), ETA Fri 2pm. Will add Docker, VSCode, VPN and `eng-dev` group. Need confirmation re: Concur access for managers.

Jordan (Eng): Start with `eng-dev`. We'll review `eng-prod` at 30-day check. I can be buddy week 1 and run infra + repo walkthrough.

Ava (Recruiting): I'll schedule recruiter 1:1 in week 1 and share hiring rubric.

Maya (People Ops): Minimal week-1 manager agenda (copyable):
Mon: 09:00 quick ops + welcome (15m), 10:00 team kickoff (30m)
Tue: buddy shadow + infra walkthrough (60m)
Wed: PM product context (30m)
Thu: draft 30/60/90 + hiring sync (45m)
Fri: skip-level cafe + week1 retro (30m)

Maya (People Ops): 30/60/90 bullets to draft (one-liners):
30d: meet team, ship a docs/infra onboarding win
60d: lead planning, propose two process improvements
90d: own a roadmap slice, hire/mentor signals ready

onboard-bot: Reminder set: "Nora - prestart checklist" Fri 17:00 PT.

Riley (IT): :white_check_mark: Device & imaging done. Will DM tracking.

Jordan (Eng): :white_check_mark: Buddy + schedule confirmed. I'll add a tiny first-PR task.

Ava (Recruiting): :white_check_mark: Recruiter 1:1 and hiring rubric sent.

Maya (People Ops): Thanks team. I'll post final Notion page and DM Nora the week-1 calendar + links. React with :white_check_mark: when your items are complete.
